_comment: All builds include POI layers by default (the map renders POIs from the tiles only). Set "includePoi": false to opt out. Optionally set "excludeLayers": ["Baixa velocidade", "Trilha", "Proibido"] to drop specific way layers. The included layer names get stamped into the archive metadata so the app only shows toggles for layers that are really in the tiles. Tippecanoe maxzoom defaults to 13 in generate-pmtiles.js; set "maximumZoom": 15+ for analysis archives (also enables --no-tile-size-limit).
